question_or_hypothesis: anthocyanin-like/red flower states are favoured by colder thermal environments across Camellia
key_project_evidence: coarse genus-wide A/W thermal comparisons and history-controlled tests were null; range-tail estimates were strongly provenance-sensitive
public_data_boundary: none needed to retain the negative genus-wide conclusion
next_empirical_or_new_data: do not repeat genus-wide annual-climate screens

question_or_hypothesis: anthocyanin-like A states are globally concentrated in a uniquely permissive nuclear lineage background
key_project_evidence: FastTree/ASTRAL A MPD P=0.1756; wASTRAL A MPD P=0.1686 and MNTD P=0.0537
public_data_boundary: not a missing-data problem; stronger nuclear topology also fails the strong form

question_or_hypothesis: visible flower-colour states are constrained by lineage/history across the nuclear backbone
key_project_evidence: FastTree/ASTRAL same-state MPD P=0.00399 and nearest-same-state P=0.000620; wASTRAL replication P=0.00346 and 0.000660
public_data_boundary: none for the root-independent conservatism claim
next_empirical_or_new_data: empirical work should ask what lineage-linked ecological/genetic traits create the constraint

question_or_hypothesis: the Camellia crown ancestor was white-like W
key_project_evidence: Fitch root=W; model-averaged W is top state in all four Mk treatments; W=0.9698-0.9962 with ASTRAL branch lengths and 0.5538-0.7383 under unit-edge sensitivity
public_data_boundary: unit-edge treatment retains meaningful W/Y uncertainty
next_empirical_or_new_data: additional taxon colour data and a stronger rooted94 tree can refine but are not required for the paper's main claim

question_or_hypothesis: some independent macro branches represent robust W-to-A endpoint-state changes after model uncertainty
key_project_evidence: three branches B011/B073/B083 pass same-direction-all-four-treatments plus minimum posterior >=0.5; B011 and B073 relationships persist on wASTRAL91
public_data_boundary: B083 cannot be checked on runtime91 because C. japonica was added only in rooted94
next_empirical_or_new_data: matched branch-focused field/molecular sampling should use these events as targets

question_or_hypothesis: similar pigment states can be reached through hierarchical reuse with paralog substitution rather than universal exact-node reuse
key_project_evidence: FLS same-paralog CnFLS2-like recurrence; DFR CsDFRa-like vs CsDFRb2 resolved different-paralog implementation; ANS/ANR copy-specific directional heterogeneity
public_data_boundary: macro enrichment is separate and remains underidentified
next_empirical_or_new_data: measure the same paralog-resolved modules across matched macro transition pairs

question_or_hypothesis: module-level reuse is enriched across independent macro colour transitions more strongly than exact-paralog reuse
key_project_evidence: only B083 has branch-assignable paralog-resolved public mechanism; B011 extant reticulata evidence cannot identify the basal event; B073 lacks a resolved mechanism cluster; strict FLS micro recurrence lies outside the robust W-to-A set
public_data_boundary: fewer than two independent robust W-to-A branches have branch-assignable paralog-resolved mechanisms
next_empirical_or_new_data: paralog-specific FLS/DFR/ANS/ANR expression plus pigment chemistry for B073 pair B083 pair and resolved B011 pair

question_or_hypothesis: robust W-to-A events consistently occupy colder local sister contexts
key_project_evidence: B073 BIO1/BIO6=-3.4/-7.2 C; B083=-1.6/-2.0 C; B011 is also colder only under C. albogigas to accepted C. granthamiana occurrence alias; alias vs exact-name q05 differs by 18.215 C
public_data_boundary: taxon-concept-matched median climate for the exact C. albogigas lineage is absent; accepted-synonym occurrence evidence is unstable
next_empirical_or_new_data: collect locality/environment data tied to the actual nuclear C. albogigas lineage; separately test flowering-window weather

question_or_hypothesis: effective pollination-service reliability/quality filters which accessible floral states persist
key_project_evidence: 0/3 robust W-to-A branches have paired branch-assignable direct service evidence; C. reticulata and C. japonica provide positive within-lineage mechanistic evidence but sisters lack matched comparisons
public_data_boundary: published studies do not provide matched descendant-vs-sister service-quality measurements
next_empirical_or_new_data: guild visitation; single-visit pollen deposition; pollen removal; bird/insect exclusion; fruit/seed set; flowering-window weather; nectar; spectra

question_or_hypothesis: selection can reduce costly/inefficient bee exploitation while preserving effective bird-mediated pollen transfer
key_project_evidence: C. japonica visual bee-avoidance evidence and C. oleifera theasaponin/bird-function evidence show two mechanistic routes with different visible colours
public_data_boundary: no phylogenetically matched branch-level conflict metric across robust transitions
next_empirical_or_new_data: measure pollen economy and visitor efficiency rather than visitation frequency alone

question_or_hypothesis: selection acts on multidimensional spectral/chemical/reward states rather than coarse human-visible A/W/Y
key_project_evidence: visible hue and pollination function are heterogeneous; UV/fluorescence/reward evidence exists only for a small subset
public_data_boundary: matched UV/visible/fluorescence/reward data are sparse across transition pairs
next_empirical_or_new_data: standardized reflectance UV fluorescence nectar and pigment chemistry on matched branch pairs

question_or_hypothesis: retained pigment pathways allow history-dependent reversals/reactivation instead of irreversible pathway loss
key_project_evidence: white-containing micro systems generally retain pathway genes and reversible developmental/within-lineage switches occur; robust macro branch event counts do not identify hidden reversals
public_data_boundary: ancestral branch-specific regulatory states are unavailable from public extant data
next_empirical_or_new_data: matched developmental expression chemistry and regulatory assays in transition/sister pairs
